Taiko Kai offers holistic development through providing a variety of opportunities for members to be involved: typical practices for honing drumming techniques, the maintenance and care of our equipment, creative work such as uniform-making and designing promotional material, and experiencing the range of venues and organizations that invite us to perform for them. clubs.name: The Association of Library and Information Science Students at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Supports UW library and information science students.
clubs.description: ALISS connects library and information science students through panels, mixers, and online events. It offers a space to learn about the MLIS program and meet peers across campuses.

clubs.name: the BASEMENT
clubs.about: Student‑run gallery and magazine showcasing campus art.
clubs.description: The BASEMENT offers gallery shows where students can exhibit their work and publishes magazines highlighting local art. Join for openings, music, drinks, and a supportive creative community.

clubs.name: The Black Student Journal
clubs.about: Publishes Black student writing and hosts reading discussions.
clubs.description: The Black Student Journal creates a space for literary exchange, hosting reading clubs, book exchanges, and discussions of works like W.E.B. Du Bois, fostering community among UW students.

clubs.name: The Dirty Dozen Student Farm Club
clubs.about: Student farm group exploring the full food system cycle on campus.
clubs.description: The Dirty Dozen is a UW student farm group that works the full food‑system cycle. Members meet for potlucks, plot work, and crafts while learning about sustainable agriculture.

clubs.name: The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students ( FIUTS ) Student Board
clubs.about: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through…
clubs.description: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through crosscultural experiences, student leadership, and community connections.

clubs.name: The Hiking Club at UW
clubs.about: Student hiking club exploring Washington’s trails year‑round.
clubs.description: The UW Hiking Club organizes regular hikes across Washington’s scenic spots, from waterfalls to mountain passes. Members connect on Discord for trip details, cold‑plunge sessions, and seasonal outings.

clubs.name: THE KOMPANY
clubs.about: UW K‑Pop dance cover group creating choreography and performances.
clubs.description: THE KOMPANY is UW’s first K‑Pop dance cover crew, creating YouTube videos, performances, and original choreography. They offer workshops for all skill levels and host fun events like cookie‑decorating nights. Join to dance, learn, and share the K‑Pop vibe.

clubs.name: The Purple Group
clubs.about: Peer support network for undocumented and DACA students at UW.
clubs.description: The Purple Group offers a safe, peer‑led space for undocumented and DACA students to share resources, study together, and celebrate their cultures. Regular meet‑ups include scholarship workshops, study nights, and community‑building activities.

clubs.name: The Women’s Network at UW
clubs.about: Women‑led network promoting ambition and community at UW.
clubs.description: The Women’s Network connects students through socials, podcasts, and creative events that celebrate ambition and well‑being. It offers a supportive space for women and allies to share ideas and grow together.

clubs.name: Theta Xi Fraternity
clubs.about: Fraternity dedicated to leadership, service, and brotherhood.
clubs.description: Theta Xi is the Upsilon Chapter at UW, founded in 1915 and upholding a record of zero violations. The fraternity emphasizes leading and serving its members and community. Social events like Casino Night bring brothers together for fun.

clubs.name: Triangle Fraternity
clubs.about: Engineering, science, and architecture fraternity for UW students.
clubs.description: Triangle Fraternity brings together engineers, scientists, and architects for camaraderie and shared interests. Members engage in creative and social activities on campus.

clubs.name: Tzu Chi Collegiate Association Seattle Chapter
clubs.about: Volunteer group focused on humanitarian service in Seattle.
clubs.description: Seattle Tzu Ching organizes community service projects such as writing letters for elders, making dog toys for shelters, and holiday events, inviting students to give back and connect through volunteer work.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Business Council
clubs.about: Student org fostering leadership, collaboration, and inclusion in Foster Business.
clubs.description: UBC connects undergraduates through mentorship programs, forums with faculty, and community events. It aims to build leadership skills and an inclusive environment within the Foster School of Business.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Theater Society
clubs.about: Student theatre society creating inclusive productions and learning opportunities.
clubs.description: The Undergraduate Theatre Society produces inclusive plays and provides learning opportunities for all undergraduates. Their current production, Trouble in Mind, invites the campus community to enjoy live theatre.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Women in Business ( UWiB )
clubs.about: Undergraduate women’s business organization at UW fostering leadership and skills.
clubs.description: UWiB hosts workshops like consumer‑insight case studies and AI skill series, helping members build real‑world business skills. Events such as Closing the Gap bring diverse voices together to network and learn.

clubs.name: United Nations Association University of Washington Chapter
clubs.about: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN…
clubs.description: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN and strengthen the UN system. We advocate for the UN, stand up for human rights, and learn how to meet UN sustainability goals.

clubs.name: University of Washington SDS
clubs.about: Student group promoting progressive politics and activism on campus.
clubs.description: UW SDS is a chapter of Students for a Democratic Society, focusing on democratic reforms, anti‑racist work, and campus activism. They organize teach‑ins, protests against trans‑phobic speakers, and campaigns like divestment from fossil‑fuel‑linked companies.

clubs.name: Urban Accessibility Group
clubs.about: A coalition of students at UW working to catalogue accessibility challenges present in pedestrian infrastructure…
clubs.description: A coalition of students at UW working to catalogue accessibility challenges present in pedestrian infrastructure around Seattle via community walk audits and data analytics.

clubs.name: UW Counseling Center
clubs.about: Provides mental health services and supportive events for UW students.
clubs.description: UW Counseling Center shares mental‑health resources and hosts supportive events such as art nights and discussion workshops. It aims to create a safe, inclusive space for all Huskies.

clubs.name: UW GWSS RSO
clubs.about: Student org fostering feminist, queer, and intersectional community work.
clubs.description: The GWSS RSO creates a supportive space for feminist, queer, and intersectional dialogue. Members collaborate on projects like writing a manifesto and discuss topics such as autonomy in their Feminism NOW sessions.

clubs.name: UW Recreation
clubs.about: University recreation offering classes and activities for student wellbeing.
clubs.description: UW Recreation offers a wide range of activities to support student wellbeing, from yoga teacher training to belay technique classes. Join to learn new skills and stay active on campus.

clubs.name: @uw_oscmc
clubs.about: Student club focused on supply chain and operations management.
clubs.description: OSCMC hosts networking events for students interested in supply chain and operations. Their Fall Networking Night offers meaningful conversations and insights into the field. Connect with peers and professionals to expand your knowledge.

clubs.name: @uw_stf
clubs.about: Provides funding support and proposal guidance for student projects.
clubs.description: The @uw_stf club offers workshops to guide students through the proposal and funding process. Their Fall Quarter Proposal Workshop helps members craft strong project proposals.

clubs.name: Venture Capital Club
clubs.about: We are bringing students interested in venture capital and startups together.
clubs.description: We are bringing students interested in venture capital and startups together.

clubs.name: Viable Veganism at UW
clubs.about: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty.
clubs.description: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty. We welcome everyone.

clubs.name: VisionEyes PreOptometry Club
clubs.about: Provides resources, networking, and insights for students pursuing optometry.
clubs.description: The Pre‑Optometry Club offers future optometrists resources, Q&A sessions with professionals, and insights into the field. Activities include guest speaker panels, story takeovers, and discussions on AI applications in eye care.

clubs.name: VSAUW
clubs.about: Vietnamese cultural association for UW students.
clubs.description: VSAUW celebrates Vietnamese heritage through social events, cultural activities, and community gatherings. Members enjoy discounts on events, themed gatherings, and opportunities to connect with fellow students.

clubs.name: Washington iGEM
clubs.about: Undergraduate team researching synthetic biology for the iGEM competition.
clubs.description: Washington iGEM is an interdisciplinary student team conducting synthetic biology projects for the global iGEM contest. Members collaborate on research and apply to join the program each year.

clubs.name: Washington Men’s Gymnastics
clubs.about: Washington Men’s Gymnastics team representing UW in collegiate gymnastics.
clubs.description: Washington Men’s Gymnastics shares training updates, team gatherings, and offers a holiday clinic for young gymnasts. The program showcases collegiate‑level coaching and promotes the sport on campus.

clubs.name: Washington Public Interest Research Group
clubs.about: Student public interest research group focusing on activism and policy.
clubs.description: WashPIRG at UW brings students together to research and advocate on public interest issues, from environmental policy to consumer protection. They run campaigns like Earth & Energy and host informational tables on campus. Join to learn, campaign, and make a difference.

clubs.name: Washington Women’s Lacrosse Club
clubs.about: Competitive women's lacrosse team with multiple regional championships.
clubs.description: UW Women's Lacrosse fields a top‑ranked team competing in regional championships. The club holds open tryouts, team events, and community fundraisers such as bake sales.

clubs.name: Washington Yacht Club
clubs.about: Student-run sailing club teaching sailing and hosting boat events at UW.
clubs.description: Washington Yacht Club provides sailing lessons, keelboat clinics, and organizes boat moves and social sails. Members can crew on a fleet that includes the Catalina Capri 22 and connect through meetings and a Discord community.

clubs.name: WGA Magic: The Gathering
clubs.about: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a…
clubs.description: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a variety of different formats. Join the discord to learn more about how to get involved here https://discord.gg/Mfmg84f

clubs.name: WiUX: Women in User Experience
clubs.about: Community linking women in UX and related fields via events, newsletters, and workshops.
clubs.description: Women in User Experience creates a supportive network for women pursuing UX design, research, and related careers. They offer a monthly newsletter, panels with industry professionals, and workshops on portfolio building and personal branding. Join to grow skills, connect with peers, and explore career paths.

clubs.name: Women Empowerment through Collaborations, Awareness, and Resources for Education
clubs.about: Women’s health education and empowerment group at UW.
clubs.description: WE CARE UW builds awareness and resources for women’s health locally and globally, partnering with organizations like the YWCA. Members lead fundraisers, fitness classes, and volunteer shifts supporting women experiencing homelessness.

clubs.name: Women in Chemical Engineering at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Community empowering women in chemical engineering via mentorship and professional events.
clubs.description: Women in Chemical Engineering supports female students through networking, mentorship, and career‑building events. They host annual showcases like CHEM‑UPS where undergraduates present research and connect with industry speakers. It's a great place to build skills and find community in the engineering field.

clubs.name: Women in Computing
clubs.about: RSO for women and non‑binary computing students at UW.
clubs.description: Women in Computing provides a community for women and non‑binary CSE majors, offering socials, outreach to K‑12 schools, and committees that shape events and online presence. Members build connections and support each other in tech.

clubs.name: Women in Informatics
clubs.about: Diversity org empowering women and allies to lead in tech.
clubs.description: UW Women in Informatics supports women in tech through creative events, hackathons, and community‑building activities like Clay & Chat. Open to all genders and majors, it fosters collaboration and leadership.

clubs.name: Women’s Ice Hockey Club UW Chapter
clubs.about: UW's women's ice hockey club.
clubs.description: The Women’s Ice Hockey Club at UW fields a house team that competes at the Kraken Community Iceplex. They post game updates, streams, and player interviews for the campus community.

clubs.name: Women’s Rugby at UW
clubs.about: UW's inclusive womxn’s rugby club.
clubs.description: The Womxn’s Husky Rugby Club is the university’s official rugby team for womxn, welcoming players of all skill levels. They compete in matches against regional rivals such as Central Washington University and share game highlights on Instagram.

clubs.name: Women’s Water Polo Club at University of Washington
clubs.about: Competitive women’s water polo team representing UW in the Northwest Division.
clubs.description: The UW Women’s Water Polo team boasts multiple division championships and competes in tournaments such as the Aztec Invitational. They share game updates, live streams, and celebrate team achievements.

clubs.name: Woof3D
clubs.about: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing.
clubs.description: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we have something for everyone. Experience is not required, and neither is any time commitment. During Fall Quarter, we hold weekly workshops mostly aimed towards beginners. These will teach the basics of 3D modeling in OnShape, as well as how to print using the club printers. We also provide members with the opportunity to work on a larger scale 3D printing project with other members throughout the year. Joining a team is not required, but it is a good way to get hands on experience and learn more about hardware and software in the process. Check out our website to learn more!

clubs.name: Writers in Progress
clubs.about: Interested in creative writing?
clubs.description: Interested in creative writing? We create a positive, casual space where people interested in a variety of forms of creative writing can meet and provide each other with support and feedback. Bring something to share or just come to chat! :)
